	एक परमाणु की **संयोजकता** उसकी संयोजन क्षमता होती है। संयोजकता के योग का उपयोग रासायनिक सूत्र निर्धारित करने के लिए किया जाता है लेकिन यह अणु के द्रव्यमान का प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करता है। ***इसलिए, कथन 2 गलत है।***
	एक अणु द्वारा घेरा गया **आयतन** उसकी भौतिक अवस्था और **तापमान** और **दबाव** जैसी स्थितियों से संबंधित होता है, जैसा कि **एवोगैड्रो के नियम** द्वारा वर्णित है, न कि उसके द्रव्यमान से। ***इसलिए, कथन 4 गलत है।***

**Additional Information** 

	**परमाणु द्रव्यमान इकाई (u)**: इसे **एकीकृत द्रव्यमान** के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, यह परमाणु और आणविक भार व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली मानक इकाई है। यह स्थिर और अपनी निम्नतम अवस्था में **कार्बन-12** के एक उदासीन परमाणु के द्रव्यमान का ठीक **1/12वां** हिस्सा है।
	**मोलर द्रव्यमान**: जबकि आणविक द्रव्यमान एक एकल अणु के द्रव्यमान (**u** में) को संदर्भित करता है, **मोलर द्रव्यमान** पदार्थ के **एक मोल** (**6.022 x 10^23** अणु) के द्रव्यमान को संदर्भित करता है और इसे **ग्राम प्रति मोल (g/mol)** में व्यक्त किया जाता है। संख्यात्मक रूप से, आणविक द्रव्यमान और मोलर द्रव्यमान समान होते हैं।
	**सूत्र इकाई द्रव्यमान**: यह शब्द विशेष रूप से **आयनिक यौगिकों** (जैसे **NaCl** या **CaCl2**) के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जहाँ घटक कण अलग-अलग अणुओं के बजाय आयन होते हैं। इसकी गणना आणविक द्रव्यमान की तरह ही की जाती है।
	**रसायन विज्ञान में महत्व**: रासायनिक प्रतिक्रियाओं में  रासायनिक मात्रामिति गणना के लिए आणविक द्रव्यमान आवश्यक है, जिससे वैज्ञानिकों को उत्पाद की एक विशिष्ट मात्रा का उत्पादन करने के लिए आवश्यक अभिकारकों के सटीक **अनुपात** की गणना करने की अनुमति मिलती है।
	**गणना के उदाहरण**:
	
		**कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (CO2)**: (**1 x 12u**) + (**2 x 16u**) = **44u**.
		**मीथेन (CH4)**: (**1 x 12u**) + (**4 x 1u**) = **16u**.
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**मानक संदर्भ**: परमाणु और आणविक द्रव्यमान के लिए वर्तमान पैमाना **कार्बन-12** पर आधारित है, जिसे ऑक्सीजन पर आधारित पुराने पैमानों को बदलने के लिए **1961** में **IUPAC** द्वारा अपनाया गया था।
	**सटीकता**: **मास वर्णक्रममिति** का उपयोग करके उच्च सटीकता के साथ आणविक द्रव्यमान निर्धारित किया जा सकता है, जो आयनित अणुओं के **द्रव्यमान-से-आवेश अनुपात** को मापता है।
	**डाल्टन (Da)**: जीव विज्ञान और जैव रसायन में, **प्रोटीन** और **DNA** जैसे बड़े कार्बनिक अणुओं के द्रव्यमान का वर्णन करने के लिए **डाल्टन** इकाई का उपयोग अक्सर एकीकृत परमाणु द्रव्यमान इकाई (**u**) के स्थान पर किया जाता है।
	**ग्राम आणविक द्रव्यमान**: यह केवल **ग्राम** में व्यक्त किसी पदार्थ का आणविक द्रव्यमान है। उदाहरण के लिए, **ऑक्सीजन (O2)** का ग्राम आणविक द्रव्यमान **32g** है।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is correct regarding Gitam?

I. It is the simplest type of composition.

II. It is very simple in construction, with an easy and melodious flow of music.
questions.questionTextHi:
गीतम के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?

I. यह बंदिश का सबसे सरल प्रकार है।

II. इसकी रचना बहुत सरल है, तथा इसमें संगीत का प्रवाह सहज और मधुर है।

options.textHi: ना तो I तथा ना ही II

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Both I and II**.

**Key Points**

In the realm of **Indian Classical Music**, specifically the **Carnatic** tradition, **Gitam** (also spelled **Geetham**) is recognized as the **simplest type of musical composition**. It is designed primarily for students who have moved past basic exercises to understand the melodic structure of a **Raga**. *Hence, statement I is correct.*
A **Gitam** is characterized by its **very simple construction**. Unlike more complex forms like **Kritis** or **Varnas**, it does not have distinct sections like **Pallavi**, **Anupallavi**, and **Charana**. Instead, it features a **continuous and melodious flow** of music. *Hence, statement II is correct.*
***Hence, the correct answer is Both I and II.***

**Additional Information**

**Structural Features of Gitam:**

The term **Gitam** literally translates to "**song**." In these compositions, the **Sahitya** (lyrics) and the **Svara** (notes) are given equal importance. There are no **Sangatis** (variations) or complex **Gamaka** (ornamentations) used, making it easy for beginners to perform.
It is typically set to **Madhyama Kala** (medium tempo). The **Sahitya** often consists of praises for **Gods** and **Goddesses**, reflecting the **Bhakti** (devotional) essence of **Indian music**.

**Historical Significance:**

**Purandara Dasa**, widely revered as the **Pitamaha** (grandfather) of **Carnatic music**, is credited with standardizing the teaching methodology, which includes the **Pillari Gitams**.
The **Pillari Gitams** are usually the first few songs taught to students and are composed in praise of **Lord Ganesha**, such as the famous "**Sri Gananatha**" in **Raga Malahari**.

**Types of Gitams:**

**Samanya Gitam**: Also known as **Sanchari Gitam**, these are ordinary compositions where the **Sahitya** is religious or philosophical.
**Lakshana Gitam**: These are unique because the **Sahitya** describes the **Lakshanas** (characteristics) of the **Raga** itself, including its **Arohana** (ascending scale), **Avarohana** (descending scale), and **Varjya** notes.

**Important Points**

**Musical Components:**

**Tala**: Gitams are usually set to simple **Suladi Sapta Talas** like **Rupaka**, **Triputa**, **Dhruva**, and **Matya**.
**Language**: The lyrics are commonly found in **Sanskrit**, **Kannada**, or a specialized musical dialect known as **Bhandira Bhasha**.
**Pedagogical Role**: Learning **Gitams** is a crucial milestone for a student to grasp the **Svarupa** (personality) of different **Ragas** like **Kalyani**, **Sankarabharanam**, or **Mohanam** before advancing to the **Varnam** stage.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **I और II दोनों** है।

**Key Points** 

	**भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत** के क्षेत्र में, विशेष रूप से **कर्नाटक** परंपरा में, **गीतम** (जिसे **गीथम** भी लिखा जाता है) को **संगीत रचना के सबसे सरल प्रकार** के रूप में पहचाना जाता है। यह मुख्य रूप से उन छात्रों के लिए बनाया  गया है जो किसी **राग** की मधुर संरचना को समझने के लिए बुनियादी अभ्यासों से आगे बढ़ चुके हैं। *अतः, कथन I सही है।*
	एक **गीतम** की विशेषता इसकी **बहुत ही सरल संरचना** है। **कृति** या **वर्णम** जैसे अधिक जटिल रूपों के विपरीत, इसमें **पल्लवी**, **अनुपल्लवी** और **चरण** जैसे अलग-अलग खंड नहीं होते हैं। इसके बजाय, इसमें संगीत का एक **निरंतर और मधुर प्रवाह** होता है। *अतः, कथन II सही है।*
	***अतः, सही उत्तर I और II दोनों है।***

**Additional Information** 

	**गीतम की संरचनात्मक विशेषताएं:**

	
		**गीतम** शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ "**गीत**" है। इन रचनाओं में, **साहित्य** (गीत के बोल) और **स्वर** (नोट्स) को समान महत्व दिया जाता है। इसमें किसी भी **संगति** (विविधता) या जटिल **गमक** (अलंकरण) का उपयोग नहीं किया जाता है, जिससे शुरुआती लोगों के लिए इसे प्रस्तुत करना आसान हो जाता है।
		यह आमतौर पर **मध्यम काल** (मध्यम गति) में सेट किया जाता है। **साहित्य** में अक्सर **देवी-देवताओं** की स्तुति होती है, जो **भारतीय संगीत** के **भक्ति** सार को दर्शाती है।
	
	
	**ऐतिहासिक महत्व:**
	
		**पुरंदर दास**, जिन्हें व्यापक रूप से **कर्नाटक संगीत** के **पितामह** के रूप में पूजा जाता है, को शिक्षण पद्धति को मानकीकृत करने का श्रेय दिया जाता है, जिसमें **पिल्लारी गीतम** शामिल हैं।
		**पिल्लारी गीतम** आमतौर पर छात्रों को सिखाए जाने वाले पहले कुछ गीत होते हैं और **भगवान गणेश** की स्तुति में रचे जाते हैं, जैसे कि **राग मलहरी** में प्रसिद्ध "**श्री गणनाथा**"।
	
	
	**गीतम के प्रकार:**
	
		**सामान्य गीतम**: इसे **संचारी गीतम** के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, ये साधारण रचनाएँ हैं जहाँ **साहित्य** धार्मिक या दार्शनिक होता है।
		**लक्षण गीतम**: ये अद्वितीय हैं क्योंकि इनका **साहित्य** स्वयं **राग** के **लक्षणों** का वर्णन करता है, जिसमें इसका **आरोहण** (चढ़ता क्रम), **अवरोहण** (उतरता क्रम), और **वर्ज्य** स्वर शामिल हैं।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**संगीत के घटक:**

	
		**ताल**: गीतम आमतौर पर **रूपक**, **त्रिपुट**, **ध्रुव** और **मत्य** जैसे सरल **सुलादि सप्त तालों** में सेट होते हैं।
		**भाषा**: गीत के बोल आमतौर पर **संस्कृत**, **कन्नड़**, या एक विशेष संगीत बोली में पाए जाते हैं जिसे **भंडीरा भाषा** के रूप में जाना जाता है।
		**शैक्षणिक भूमिका**: **वर्णम** चरण में आगे बढ़ने से पहले **कल्याणी**, **शंकराभरणम**, या **मोहनम** जैसे विभिन्न **रागों** के **स्वरूप** (व्यक्तित्व) को समझने के लिए **गीतम** सीखना एक छात्र के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर है।

questions.questionText: EnviStats India 2025: Environment Statistics has been released by which of the following?
questions.questionTextHi: एनवीस्टेट्स इंडिया 2025: पर्यावरण सांख्यिकी निम्नलिखित में से किसके द्वारा जारी की गई है?

options.text: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
options.textHi: पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation**.

**Key Points**

The **EnviStats India 2025: Environment Statistics** is a flagship publication released by the **National Statistical Office (NSO)**, which operates under the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** of the Government of India.
The report provides comprehensive **data and statistics** related to the environment, including **physical assets**, **biodiversity**, **forests**, and **climate-related indicators** within the Indian territory.
The publication follows the **System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA)** framework, which is the international statistical standard for environmental-economic accounting adopted by the **United Nations Statistical Commission** in **2012**.
It aims to bridge the gap between **economic policy** and **environmental sustainability** by providing **quantitative data** that helps in assessing the impact of economic activities on natural resources.
The **2025 edition** (and its predecessors) serves as a critical resource for monitoring **India’s progress** towards the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly those concerning **Clean Water and Sanitation (SDG 6)**, **Climate Action (SDG 13)**, and **Life on Land (SDG 15)**.

**Additional Information**

**Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**

This **Ministry** was created as an independent entity on **15th October 1999** following the merger of the **Department of Statistics** and the **Department of Programme Implementation**.
The **National Statistical Office (NSO)** under this ministry is responsible for the conduct of large-scale sample surveys and the **compilation of national accounts**, including the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**.

**System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA):**

The **SEEA framework** integrates economic and environmental data to provide a **multipurpose information system** for understanding the interactions between the **economy and the environment**.
It facilitates the calculation of **Green GDP**, which adjusts the traditional **GDP** by accounting for **environmental degradation** and **resource depletion**.

**Other Ministries and their Roles:**

The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** is the **nodal agency** for the planning, promotion, and coordination of **India's environmental and forestry programs**; however, the statistical compilation for **EnviStats** is handled by **MoSPI**.
The **Ministry of Home Affairs** is primarily responsible for **internal security**, **border management**, and the **Census of India** (via the Registrar General).
The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** focuses on the **welfare and empowerment** of marginalized sections of society, such as **Scheduled Castes**, **OBCs**, and **persons with disabilities**.

**Significance of EnviStats:**

The report includes detailed accounts of **land cover**, **water use**, and **solid waste management** across different **Indian states and Union Territories**.
By providing **time-series data**, it allows researchers to track **long-term environmental trends** and the efficiency of **government conservation schemes** like **Namami Gange** or the **National Afforestation Programme**.

**Important Points**

**Global Context:** India is one of the few countries that have actively implemented the **SEEA framework** to produce **Environmental Accounts**, aligning its domestic statistical practices with **global benchmarks** set by the **United Nations**.
**Data Sources:** The **MoSPI** collaborates with several technical agencies like the **Forest Survey of India (FSI)**, **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)**, and **Central Ground Water Board (CGWB)** to collect primary data for these statistical volumes.
**Scope:** **EnviStats India** is typically released in **two volumes**: Volume I focuses on **Environmental Statistics** (based on the **FDES 2013** framework), while Volume II focuses on **Environmental Accounts**.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय** है।

**Key Points** 

	**एन्विस्टैट्स इंडिया 2025: भारत पर्यावरण सांख्यिकी 2025** एक प्रमुख प्रकाशन है जिसे **राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी कार्यालय (NSO)** द्वारा जारी किया जाता है, जो भारत सरकार के **सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय (MoSPI)** के तहत कार्य करता है।
	यह अभिलेख पर्यावरण से संबंधित व्यापक आंकड़ा **और सांख्यिकी** प्रदान करती है, जिसमें भारतीय क्षेत्र के भीतर **भौतिक संपत्ति**, **जैव विविधता**, **वन** और **जलवायु से संबंधित संकेतक** शामिल हैं।
	यह प्रकाशन **पर्यावरण-आर्थिक लेखांकन प्रणाली (SEEA)** ढांचे का अनुसरण करता है, जो **2012** में **संयुक्त राष्ट्र सांख्यिकी आयोग** द्वारा अपनाए गए पर्यावरण-आर्थिक लेखांकन के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी मानक है।
	इसका उद्देश्य **आर्थिक नीति** और **पर्यावरणीय स्थिरता** के बीच की खाई को पाटना है, जो **मात्रात्मक आंकड़ा **प्रदान करता है जो प्राकृतिक संसाधनों पर आर्थिक गतिविधियों के प्रभाव का आकलन करने में मदद करता है।
	**2025 संस्करण** (और इसके पूर्ववर्ती) **सतत विकास लक्ष्यों (SDGs)** की दिशा में **भारत की प्रगति** की निगरानी के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण संसाधन के रूप में कार्य करता है, विशेष रूप से **स्वच्छ जल और स्वच्छता (SDG 6)**, **जलवायु कार्रवाई (SDG 13)**, और **भूमि पर जीवन (SDG 15)** से संबंधित लक्ष्यों के लिए।

**Additional Information** 

	**सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय (MoSPI):**

	
		यह **मंत्रालय** **15 अक्टूबर 1999** को **सांख्यिकी विभाग** और **कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन विभाग** के विलय के बाद एक स्वतंत्र इकाई के रूप में बनाया गया था।
		इस मंत्रालय के तहत **राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी कार्यालय (NSO)** बड़े पैमाने पर नमूना सर्वेक्षण करने और **सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP)** सहित **राष्ट्रीय खातों के संकलन** के लिए जिम्मेदार है।
	
	
	**पर्यावरण-आर्थिक लेखांकन प्रणाली (SEEA):**
	
		**SEEA ढांचा** **अर्थव्यवस्था और पर्यावरण** के बीच बातचीत को समझने के लिए एक **बहुउद्देशीय सूचना प्रणाली** प्रदान करने हेतु आर्थिक और पर्यावरणीय आँकड़े  को एकीकृत करता है।
		यह **हरित जीडीपी (Green GDP)** की गणना की सुविधा प्रदान करता है, जो **पर्यावरणीय गिरावट** और **संसाधन की कमी** को ध्यान में रखते हुए पारंपरिक **जीडीपी** को समायोजित करता है।
	
	
	**अन्य मंत्रालय और उनकी भूमिकाएं:**
	
		**पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय (MoEFCC)** **भारत के पर्यावरण और वानिकी कार्यक्रमों** के नियोजन, प्रचार और समन्वय के लिए **नोडल संस्था **है; हालाँकि, **पर्यावरण सांख्यिकी** के लिए सांख्यिकीय संकलन **MoSPI** द्वारा नियंत्रित किया जाता है।
		**गृह मंत्रालय** मुख्य रूप से **आंतरिक सुरक्षा**, **सीमा प्रबंधन** और (रजिस्ट्रार जनरल के माध्यम से) **भारत की जनगणना** के लिए जिम्मेदार है।
		**सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता मंत्रालय** समाज के हाशिए पर रहने वाले वर्गों, जैसे **अनुसूचित जाति**, **ओबीसी** और **दिव्यांग व्यक्तियों** के **कल्याण और सशक्तिकरण** पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है।
	
	
	**पर्यावरण सांख्यिकी** **का महत्व:**
	
		अभिलेख में विभिन्न **भारतीय राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों** में **भूमि आवरण**, **जल उपयोग** और **ठोस अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन** का विस्तृत विवरण शामिल है।
		काल-श्रृंखला आँकड़े प्रदान करके, यह शोधकर्ताओं को **दीर्घकालिक पर्यावरणीय रुझानों** और **नमामि गंगे** या **राष्ट्रीय वनीकरण कार्यक्रम** जैसी **सरकारी संरक्षण योजनाओं** की दक्षता को पता  करने की अनुमति देता है।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**वैश्विक संदर्भ:** भारत उन कुछ देशों में से एक है जिन्होंने **पर्यावरण खाते** तैयार करने के लिए **SEEA ढांचे** को सक्रिय रूप से लागू किया है, जिससे अपने घरेलू सांख्यिकीय प्रथाओं को **संयुक्त राष्ट्र** द्वारा निर्धारित **वैश्विक मानक **के साथ जोड़ा गया है।
	**आंकड़ा स्रोत:** **MoSPI** इन सांख्यिकीय संस्करणों के लिए प्राथमिक आँकड़े एकत्र करने के लिए **भारतीय वन सर्वेक्षण (FSI)**, **केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण मण्डल (CPCB)** और **केंद्रीय भूजल मंडल  (CGWB)** जैसी कई तकनीकी संस्थाओं  के साथ सहयोग करता है।
	**दायरा:** **EnviStats India** आमतौर पर **दो खंडों** में जारी किया जाता है: खंड I **पर्यावरण सांख्यिकी** (**FDES 2013** ढांचे पर आधारित) पर केंद्रित है, जबकि खंड II **पर्यावरण खातों** पर केंद्रित है।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following idiom given in the alternatives has the meaning?
Enjoy oneself very much

options.text: Have a nick of a time
Have a click of a time
Have a whale of a time
Have a shell of a time

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Have a whale of a time .

**Key Points**

The idiom **"Have a whale of a time"** means to enjoy oneself very much or have a great time.
It is often used in informal contexts to describe a fun or exciting experience.
None of the other options (1, 2, or 4) convey this meaning, making option 3 the correct choice.

Correct sentence: *We had a whale of a time at the party last night.*

**Additional Information**

**Idioms and their meanings:**

**Have a nick of a time:** Not a commonly used idiom or phrase.
**Have a click of a time:** Not a recognized idiom in English.
**Have a shell of a time:** Doesn't carry the intended meaning of enjoying oneself.

**Using idioms:** Idioms are phrases that have figurative meanings, and they are often tied to cultural or linguistic contexts.

questions.questionText: Choose the correctly spelt word from the given options.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Fascination .

**Key Points**

The word **Fascination** refers to the state of being fascinated or attracted to something strongly.
The correct spelling of the word is **Fascination**.
Option 1 (**Fasination**) and Option 2 (**Fascinacion**) are incorrect because they are misspelled versions of the word.

Correct word: *Fascination*

**Additional Information**

**Root Word:** The word originates from the Latin root "fascinare," meaning to captivate or bewitch.
**Usage in a Sentence:** Her fascination with astronomy led her to pursue a career in space science.

questions.questionText:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option "No replacement required".

The doctor diagnosed her with kleptomenia, a disorder that caused her to steal compulsively.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. kleptomania .

**Key Points**

The word **kleptomenia** in the sentence is misspelled.
The correct spelling of the word is **kleptomania**, which refers to a psychological disorder causing an uncontrollable urge to steal items.
Option 2, **kleptomania**, is the correct replacement for the misspelled word.
Options 1 (**Kleptominia**) and 3 (**klaptomania**) are incorrect spellings.
Option 4 (**No replacement required**) is incorrect because the spelling in the sentence needs correction.

Correct sentence: *The doctor diagnosed her with **kleptomania**, a disorder that caused her to steal compulsively*.

**Additional Information**

**Kleptomania:** A mental health disorder characterized by repeated inability to resist urges to steal things not needed for personal use or monetary value.
It is classified as an impulse control disorder in psychiatry.
It is important to use the correct spelling to convey the intended meaning clearly.

questions.questionText:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.

The summit emphasised multilateral cooperation to address pressing global issues such as climate change and terrorisim.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. terrorisim .

**Key Points**

The sentence provided highlights global issues such as climate change and terrorism.
There are four underlined words in the sentence: **multilateral**, **cooperation**, **pressing**, and **terrorisim**.
Among these words, **terrorisim** is misspelt.
The correct spelling of the word is **terrorism**.

Correct sentence: *The summit emphasised multilateral cooperation to address pressing global issues such as climate change and **terrorism**.*

**Additional Information**

**Spelling errors** can often occur due to typographical mistakes or confusion over the correct form of a word.
It is important to use accurate spelling in formal writing, especially when addressing serious topics such as terrorism.

questions.questionText: Choose the misspelt word from the given options.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Ludicurous .

**Key Points**

The word **"Ludicurous"** is misspelt.
The correct spelling of the word is **"Ludicrous"**, which means something that is absurd or ridiculous.
The other words in the options are correctly spelt:

**Cemetery:** A burial ground, typically one that is not attached to a church.
**Punctuate:** To insert punctuation marks in a text.
**Indolence:** Avoidance of activity or exertion; laziness.

Correct word: *Ludicrous*

**Additional Information**

**Commonly misspelt words:** English contains many words that are often misspelt, such as:

**Accommodate:** Often misspelt as "acommodate" or "accomodate."
**Separate:** Often misspelt as "seperate."
**Definitely:** Often misspelt as "definately."

To avoid spelling errors, it is advisable to:

Use spell-check tools while writing.
Regularly practice and familiarize yourself with commonly misspelt words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to **“dig”**.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Fill .

**Key Points**

The word "dig" refers to the act of making a hole in the ground or removing earth.
Among the options:

**Excavate** means to dig out material from the ground, which is similar in meaning to "dig."
**Burrow** refers to digging or tunneling, often associated with animals, and is again similar to "dig."
**Fill** means to put material into a space or hole, which is the opposite of "dig."
**Unearth** means to dig up or uncover something, which is similar in meaning to "dig."

Hence, the word most opposite in meaning to "dig" is **Fill**.

Correct sentence: *The word most opposite in meaning to "dig" is **Fill**.*

**Additional Information**

**Synonyms of "dig":** Excavate, Unearth, Burrow.
**Antonyms of "dig":** Fill, Cover, Patch.
Understanding synonyms and antonyms is essential for improving vocabulary and comprehension skills.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Get back**.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Lose.

**Key Points**

The question asks for the antonym of the phrase **"Get back"**, which means to regain or recover something.
Out of the options given:

**Regain:** Synonym of "Get back," meaning to recover something.
**Retrieve:** Synonym of "Get back," referring to bringing something back.
**Recover:** Synonym of "Get back," indicating restoration or reclamation.
**Lose:** Antonym of "Get back," as it means to be deprived of or unable to retain something.

Correct sentence: *The antonym of "Get back" is **Lose**.*

**Additional Information**

**Synonyms:** Words with similar meanings that can be used interchangeably (e.g., regain, retrieve, recover).
**Antonyms:** Words with opposite meanings (e.g., lose).

questions.questionText: The word "bank" is a homonym. In which sentence does it mean the side of a river?

options.text: She deposited her salary in the bank.
They had a picnic on the bank of the Ganga.
He decided to bank on his friends for support.
The central bank controls the country’s money supply.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. They had a picnic on the bank of the Ganga.

**Key Points**

The word "bank" is a homonym, meaning it has multiple meanings depending on the context in which it is used.
The sentence **"They had a picnic on the bank of the Ganga"** clearly refers to the meaning of "bank" as the side of a river.
Other options use different meanings of the word "bank":

Option 1: Refers to a financial institution.
Option 3: Refers to relying or depending on something.
Option 4: Refers to the central financial authority.

Correct sentence: *They had a picnic on the bank of the Ganga.*

**Additional Information**

**Homonyms:** Words that have the same spelling or pronunciation but different meanings. For example:

**Bank (River):** The side of a river.
**Bank (Financial):** A place where money is deposited and withdrawn.

It is important to understand the context of the sentence to correctly interpret the meaning of a homonym.

questions.questionText:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who has no money.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Pauper.

**Key Points**

The term **pauper** refers to a person who is extremely poor and has no money or means to support themselves.
**Miser:** A miser is someone who hoards money and is reluctant to spend it, not necessarily poor.
**Tycoon:** A tycoon is a wealthy and powerful businessperson, which is the opposite of being poor.
**Patron:** A patron is someone who financially supports others, often in the arts or charity, which also implies wealth rather than poverty.

Correct word: *A person who has no money is called a **pauper**.*

**Additional Information**

**Word Substitution:** This is a form of vocabulary exercise where a sentence or phrase is replaced with a single word that conveys the same meaning.
**Example:**

Sentence: A person who writes books for others. **Word:** Ghostwriter.
Sentence: A place where animals are kept. **Word:** Zoo.

questions.questionText:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

An athletic event comprising ten different events.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Decathlon.

**Key Points**

The term **Decathlon** refers to an athletic competition comprising ten different events.
The root word *"Deca"* means ten, which is derived from the Greek word *déka*.
The other options are as follows:

**Pentathlon:** A competition with five events (*Penta* means five).
**Tetrathlon:** A competition with four events (*Tetra* means four).
**Heptathlon:** A competition with seven events (*Hepta* means seven).

Correct sentence: *An athletic event comprising ten different events is called a **Decathlon**.*

**Additional Information**

**Decathlon:** The competition typically consists of events like 100m sprint, long jump, shot put, high jump, 400m race, 110m hurdles, discus throw, pole vault, javelin throw, and 1500m race.
**Origin:** Decathlon is a modern event in athletics, primarily conducted in track and field sports.
**Participants:** Athletes competing in a Decathlon are often referred to as "decathletes" and need to be versatile across multiple disciplines.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

People believed that he was innocent.

options.text: It will believe that he was innocent.
He was believe to be innocent by people.
It was believed that he was innocent.
His innocence was believe by people.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. It was believed that he was innocent.

**Key Points**

The given sentence is in the **active voice**: "People believed that he was innocent."
To convert this sentence into the **passive voice**, the following changes are required:

The object of the active sentence ("that he was innocent") becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
The verb "believed" is changed to its passive form "was believed."
The subject of the active sentence ("People") is either omitted (as it's a general reference) or retained in a prepositional phrase starting with "by."

Therefore, the correct passive voice conversion is: **"It was believed that he was innocent."**

Correct sentence: *It was believed that he was innocent.*

**Additional Information**

**Key rules for converting active to passive voice:**

The object of the active voice becomes the subject in the passive voice.
The verb is replaced with its corresponding passive form: **be + past participle**.
The subject of the active voice is either omitted (if it's a general reference) or introduced using "by."

**Example:**

Active: "The team completed the project."
Passive: "The project was completed by the team."

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Didn't the manager inform all the employees about the new rule?

options.text: Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?
Wasn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?
Didn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?
Doesn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?

**Key Points**

The given sentence is in the **interrogative** form of the **active voice**, starting with "Didn't."
When converting such sentences into the **passive voice**, the structure becomes: **Wasn't/Weren't + subject (object of active voice) + past participle + by + agent (doer).**
In the active voice, "the manager" is the subject, "all the employees" is the object, and the verb is "inform."
In the passive voice, the object "all the employees" becomes the subject, and the verb changes to the past participle "informed."
Option 1 correctly follows this structure: **Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?**

Correct sentence: *Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2:** "Wasn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?" is incorrect because "employees" is plural, so the correct auxiliary verb should be "Weren't," not "Wasn't."
**Option 3:** "Didn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?" is incorrect because "informed" is not used correctly as a past participle in the passive voice.
**Option 4:** "Doesn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?" is incorrect because it mixes present tense ("Doesn't") with past participle "informed," which is grammatically wrong.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

You are requested to come early tomorrow.

options.text: I request your early coming tomorrow.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Please come early tomorrow.

**Key Points**

The given sentence is in the** passive voice**, as it starts with "You are requested," indicating a polite request.
In the active voice, the sentence needs to be rewritten to directly convey the request while maintaining the same meaning.
Option 3, "Please come early tomorrow," is the most appropriate active voice conversion because it is polite and directly conveys the request.
Options 1, 2, and 4 are either grammatically incorrect or do not match the tone and intent of the original sentence.

Correct sentence: *Please come early tomorrow*.

**Additional Information**

**Passive to Active Voice Conversion Tips:**

Identify the subject performing the action in the passive sentence.
Rewrite the sentence so that the subject appears at the beginning, performing the action.
Use appropriate verbs and maintain the tone of the original sentence (e.g., polite requests should remain polite).

**Examples:**

Passive: "The homework was completed by the student." → Active: "The student completed the homework."
Passive: "You are advised to take precautions." → Active: "Please take precautions."

questions.questionText:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

Johnsy was so angry with the stranger that she threw her sandals to him hurting just above his right eyebrow.

options.text: stranger that she threw her sandals to him
hurting just above his right eyebrow.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. stranger that she threw her sandals to him .

**Key Points**

The error lies in part 3 of the sentence: **"stranger that she threw her sandals to him."**
The preposition **"to"** is incorrectly used in this context. The correct preposition should be **"at."**
The correct phrase is: **"she threw her sandals at him."**
The preposition **"at"** is used when directing an action toward someone or something in a forceful or targeted manner.

Correct sentence: *Johnsy was so angry with the stranger that she threw her sandals at him, hurting just above his right eyebrow.*

**Additional Information**

**Usage of "to" vs. "at":**

**"To":** Indicates direction or movement toward a destination (e.g., "I gave the book to her.").
**"At":** Indicates a targeted or aggressive action (e.g., "He threw a ball at the wall.").

questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

Their surprise gift came ________ the form of a new laptop.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. in .

**Key Points**

The preposition **"in"** is used to indicate the form or manner in which something appears or is presented.
In the given sentence, the phrase "**in the form of**" is correct because it describes the way the surprise gift was presented, i.e., as a new laptop.
Other options such as **"on," "by,"** or **"of"** do not fit the context or grammatical structure of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Their surprise gift came **in** the form of a new laptop.*

**Additional Information**

The preposition **"in"** is often used in phrases like:

**In the form of:** To describe the way something is presented (e.g., "Help came in the form of donations").
**In terms of:** To specify a particular aspect or area (e.g., "The project is successful in terms of innovation").

Prepositions must be chosen carefully as they play a crucial role in maintaining the accuracy and meaning of a sentence.

questions.questionText:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The prestigious award was given to the scientist for his groundshaking research in genetics.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. groundbreaking research in genetics .

**Key Points**

The original sentence uses the term **“groundshaking,”** which is not the appropriate term in this context. While it might be understood as something impactful, it is not the correct phrase used to describe significant scientific research.
The correct phrase is **“groundbreaking research,”** which means innovative or pioneering research.
Option 1 (*groundbraking research*) contains a spelling error. The correct spelling is “groundbreaking.”
Option 2 (*groundshaking research in genetic*) contains two errors: the term “groundshaking” is incorrect, and the word “genetic” should be pluralized to “genetics.”
Option 4 (*No Improvement Required*) is incorrect because the original sentence contains an error.

Correct sentence: *The prestigious award was given to the scientist for his **groundbreaking research in genetics**.*

**Additional Information**

The term **“groundbreaking”** is commonly used in contexts involving innovation, discoveries, or major achievements.
For example:

She received a grant for her **groundbreaking** work in renewable energy.
The team made a **groundbreaking** discovery in cancer research.

questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The child wanted to hear the story ________ Vikramaditya.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. about .

**Key Points**

The child wanted to hear the story **about** Vikramaditya, which means the story is related to or concerning Vikramaditya.
Among the given options, **'about'** is the correct preposition to use, as it is commonly used to indicate the subject or topic of a story.
Other options, such as **'on'**, **'for'**, or **'in'**, do not fit the context appropriately.

Correct sentence: *The child wanted to hear the story **about** Vikramaditya*.

**Additional Information**

**'About':** Used to indicate the subject of a discussion, story, or thought (e.g., "Tell me about your day").
**'On':** Generally used to indicate a physical position or a specific topic (e.g., "The book is on the table" or "A lecture on physics").
**'For':** Indicates purpose, recipient, or benefit (e.g., "This gift is for you").
**'In':** Refers to location, time, or condition (e.g., "The keys are in the drawer" or "In the morning").

questions.questionText:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. At half-past eleven that night he drove up to the entrance of the Paris Hotel
A. He was admitted.
B. Grohol sky was packing his things in a portmanteau, Liza was sitting at the table trying on bracelets.
C. He went noisily upstairs and knocked at the door of Grohol sky's apartments.
D. They were both frightened when Bugrov went in to them.
S2. They fancied that he had come for Liza and had brought back the money which he had taken in haste without reflection.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. CABD .

**Key Points**

The paragraph begins with S1, which mentions Bugrov arriving at the Paris Hotel at night.
Next, C logically follows as Bugrov goes upstairs and knocks on Groholsky's door, maintaining the sequence of events.
Then, A follows as Bugrov is admitted into the apartment, continuing the flow of the story.
B comes next, where Groholsky is packing his things and Liza is trying on bracelets, describing the scene inside the room.
Finally, D follows as Bugrov's entry frightens both of them, leading to the conclusion in S2.

Correct sequence: *CABD*

**Additional Information**

This type of question tests your ability to logically sequence sentences to form a coherent and meaningful paragraph.
Always identify the introductory and concluding sentences, then analyze the flow of actions or events described in the jumbled sentences.

The correct answer is '3' i.e. CADB.

**Key Points**

The paragraph begins with the protagonist hearing footsteps in the corridor (S1).
Sentence C logically follows, as it describes the door opening and the appearance of Count Scarlet, which builds suspense.
Sentence A then introduces a detailed description of Count Scarlet, emphasizing his physical traits (tall, lanky, freckled, etc.).
Sentence D continues the physical description, focusing on his large hands.
Sentence B concludes the description, highlighting his knees and tightly fitting trousers.
The paragraph ends with S2, where Count Scarlet lifts his hand and speaks, adding dramatic flair.

Correct sequence: *S1 → C → A → D → B → S2*.

**Additional Information**

**Coherence:** The sequence ensures logical progression from the event (hearing footsteps) to the description of Count Scarlet and his actions.
**Unity:** All sentences are interconnected and contribute to the overall narrative of the paragraph.

questions.questionText:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: "No improvement required."

The employees, having completing the rigorous training program, felt well prepared for the upcoming challenges.

options.text: The rigorous training program, having been completed by the employees
Having completed the employees rigorous training program,
Having completed the rigorous training program, the employees

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. "Having completed the rigorous training program, the employees" .

**Key Points**

The original sentence, *"The employees, having completing the rigorous training program, felt well prepared for the upcoming challenges,"* contains a grammatical error in the phrase "**having completing**." The correct form should be "**having completed**."
Option 3, "**Having completed the rigorous training program, the employees**," correctly places the modifier "**having completed**" before the noun "**the employees**," ensuring clarity and grammatical accuracy.
Option 1 ("The rigorous training program, having been completed by the employees") is grammatically correct but changes the sentence's meaning by shifting the focus from the employees to the training program.
Option 2 ("Having completed the employees rigorous training program") is incorrect because it lacks clarity and proper structure. The phrase does not align with the intended meaning of the original sentence.
Option 4 ("No improvement required") is incorrect because the original sentence contains a grammatical error that needs correction.

Correct sentence: *Having completed the rigorous training program, the employees felt well prepared for the upcoming challenges.*

**Additional Information**

**Placement of Modifiers:** Modifiers such as "**having completed**" should be placed close to the noun they modify to avoid ambiguity.
**Verb Forms:** "**Having completed**" is the correct past participle form, indicating an action completed before another action.
In this case, the completion of the training program occurs before the employees feel prepared for the challenges.

questions.questionText: According to the passage, what should a radical vision of mental health care prioritize?

options.text: Respect for the values of dignity and disability justice and provision of constant and compassionate care.
Concerned only with medical intervention, to the point of ignoring the relational-existent aspects.
Reducing care management to short-term crisis interventions.
Refraining from dealing with complex needs and only addressing safety-related concerns.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Key Points**

To identify what the **radical vision** should prioritize, we look at the first two sentences of the passage: *"A radical vision of mental health care needs to be **centered on the ideals of dignity and disability justice**... It means simply **being there for the person, again and again**, through various sufferings..."*
The text emphasizes two main pillars:

**Principles:** Dignity, disability justice, equity, and inclusion.
**Practice:** Constant presence ("again and again") and addressing various forms of suffering (compassionate care).

**Option 1** accurately combines these elements by mentioning the respect for dignity/justice and the provision of constant, compassionate care.
Why other options are incorrect:

**Option 2:** The passage **contradicts** this by stating that care should address "relationship suffering" and "existential issues," rather than ignoring them for medical intervention.
**Option 3:** The passage suggests being there **"again and again,"** which implies long-term commitment, not just "short-term crisis interventions."
**Option 4:** The text explicitly says it needs to "account for the **complexities** at issue," directly opposing the idea of refraining from complex needs.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

**Analytical Insight:** *In high-level reading comprehension for exams, questions often focus on "Philosophy vs. Practice." This passage defines the philosophy (Dignity/Justice) and the practice (Presence/Problem-solving). The correct answer must bridge both aspects.*

**Additional Information**

**Radical Vision:** A fundamental or thorough-going change in perspective or approach.
**Dignity:** The state or quality of being worthy of honor or respect.
**Disability Justice:** A framework that examines disability and ableism as they relate to other forms of oppression and identity.
**Existential Issues:** Concerns relating to the nature of human existence, such as meaning, purpose, and mortality.

questions.questionText: Why does the passage refer to mental health care as a “complicated story”?

options.text: Because most of the mental health problems are solved with just one intervention and regular medication.
Because it must address emotional, relational, practical, and existential needs all at once.
Because care should keep away from the real-life situation.
Because mental health is a matter of medical diagnosis only.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Key Points**

To understand why the passage uses the phrase **"very complicated story,"** we look at the final sentence which lists the overlapping tasks of care.
The author explains that a radical vision requires addressing:

**Adverse life circumstances:** Practical needs and security.
**Relationship issues:** Social and emotional needs.
**Existential issues:** Deep mental and philosophical suffering.
**Daily accomplishment:** Problem-solving and functional needs.

The simultaneous management of all these diverse layers—emotional, relational, practical, and existential—is what makes the process "complicated."
Why other options are incorrect:

**Option 1:** This **contradicts** the text. The passage describes a need for being there "again and again" through various sufferings, which is the opposite of a "one-off" intervention or simple medication.
**Option 3:** The passage explicitly states that care **is** the task of addressing "adverse life circumstances," meaning it must be deeply involved in real-life situations.
**Option 4:** This is a **narrow view** that the passage is trying to move away from by focusing on "dignity," "disability justice," and "existential issues" rather than just a medical diagnosis.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

**Analytical Insight:** *In high-level Reading Comprehension, "Complexity" usually arises from the **intersection** of different factors. When a text lists multiple categories of needs that must be addressed at the same time, the "complication" lies in that holistic approach.*

**Additional Information**

**Existential:** Relating to human existence or the experience of being alive.
**Equity:** The quality of being fair and impartial, ensuring everyone has what they need to succeed.
**Disability Justice:** A movement that acknowledges that all bodies are unique and that social systems must be built to include everyone.
**Adverse:** Preventing success or development; harmful; unfavorable.

questions.questionText: In what ways does the passage explain what “being there” means in mental health care?

options.text: Brief check-ins but not dealing with underlying matters.
Offering consistent support across different kinds of suffering over time.
Overconcern with the basic needs of humans to the point of disregarding the emotional

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Key Points**

To understand what **"being there"** means, we look at the third sentence: *"It means simply being there for the person, **again and again**, through **various sufferings**..."*
The phrase **"again and again"** implies **consistency** and a long-term commitment over time.
The phrase **"various sufferings"** (relationship, existential, material needs) indicates that support should cover **different kinds** of human experiences and challenges.
**Option 2** perfectly captures both the temporal aspect (consistency over time) and the comprehensive aspect (different kinds of suffering).
Why other options are incorrect:

**Option 1:** **"Brief check-ins"** contradicts the instruction to be there "again and again" through complex sufferings.
**Option 3:** The passage says care should address **both** material needs *and* emotional/existential issues "at the same time," so it doesn't disregard the emotional.
**Option 4:** The text lists "relationship issues" and "existential issues," which are not always **"life-threatening situations,"** showing that care is meant to be much broader.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

**Analytical Insight:** *In high-level competitive exams, "being there" is a figurative expression. The passage defines it not as physical proximity, but as **steadfastness** in the face of multi-dimensional human suffering.*

**Additional Information**

**Radical:** Relating to or affecting the fundamental nature of something; far-reaching or thorough.
**Existential:** Relating to human existence or the experience of being alive.
**Equity:** The quality of being fair and impartial.
**Adverse:** Preventing success or development; harmful; unfavorable.

questions.questionText: What is the idea that best reflects the attitude of the passage with respect to the needs of mentally healthy individuals, which would involve things such as security, relationships, and a sense of accomplishment?

options.text: These are different from mental health and should be considered individually.
Only security needs have the ability to impact mental health.
The needs are considered irrelevant within a psychological framework that deals with long-term psychological distress.
These needs are interconnected and must be addressed alongside emotional and existential suffering.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Key Points**

To identify the passage's attitude toward these needs, we look at the final sentence: *"...care as the task of addressing adverse life circumstances... **while at the same time addressing needs related to security, relationship, daily accomplishment, or problem-solving**, is a very complicated story."*
The use of the phrase **"while at the same time"** indicates that these practical and social needs (security, relationships, accomplishment) are not separate from mental health care but are **interconnected** with it.
The "radical vision" described doesn't choose between fixing life circumstances and fixing the mind; it advocates for addressing **both** simultaneously.
**Option 4** perfectly reflects this holistic attitude by stating these needs must be addressed **alongside** emotional and existential suffering.
Why other options are incorrect:

**Option 1:** The passage suggests they should be addressed "at the same time," which is the opposite of considering them "individually" or as "different from mental health."
**Option 2:** This is **too restrictive**. The passage also mentions relationships, daily accomplishment, and problem-solving, not just security.
**Option 3:** This **contradicts** the text, which explicitly includes these needs as part of the "task of care" in its complicated story.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

**Analytical Insight:** *In high-level Reading Comprehension, look for "Integrative" keywords like "while," "simultaneously," or "at the same time." These words signal that the author views various elements as a **unified whole** rather than isolated parts.*

**Additional Information**

**Existential Issues:** Philosophical concerns about the meaning of life, purpose, and death.
**Disability Justice:** A movement that ensures people with disabilities have the same rights and opportunities as everyone else, with a focus on intersectionality.
**Equity:** Ensuring everyone has the specific tools they need to be successful, which is different from "equality" (giving everyone the same thing).
**Adverse:** Unfavorable or harmful circumstances.

questions.questionText: How does the passage infer the existence of suffering within mental health settings?

options.text: It only focuses on the chemical imbalance and biological factors.
This develops from a variety of sources: relational, functional, and existent.
Only treatment by medication and crisis intervention.
It can be effectively tackled by working on one aspect of an individual's life.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Key Points**

To identify how the passage **infers the sources of suffering**, we examine the third sentence: *"...through **various sufferings**, whether it be **relationship suffering**, suffering related to the **things they need**, or suffering related to **existential issues**."*
The passage breaks down suffering into three distinct categories:

**Relational:** "Relationship suffering."
**Functional/Practical:** "Suffering related to the things they need" (security, daily accomplishment).
**Existent:** "Existential issues" (meaning and purpose).

**Option 2** accurately summarizes these by stating that suffering "develops from a variety of sources: relational, functional, and existent."
Why other options are incorrect:

**Option 1:** The passage **never mentions** "chemical imbalances" or "biological factors." It focuses on life circumstances and existential weight.
**Option 3:** The text advocates for "being there... again and again" and addressing life circumstances, which is much broader than just "medication and crisis intervention."
**Option 4:** The author describes it as a **"very complicated story"** because you must address multiple needs "at the same time," contradicting the idea of working on only "one aspect."

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

**Analytical Insight:** *In high-level competitive exams, "Inference" questions require you to categorize specific examples from the text into broader academic terms. "Things they need" becomes Functional, "Relationships" becomes Relational, and "Existential" remains Existent.*

**Additional Information**

**Radical Vision:** A fundamental change in the way something is viewed or treated.
**Disability Justice:** A framework that centers the lives and leadership of disabled people of color and queer/trans disabled people.
**Existential:** Relating to human existence or the experience of being alive.
**Equity:** The quality of being fair and impartial, providing specific support based on individual needs.
